sources.title: Document AI release notes | Google Cloud Documentation
sources.snippet: Document AI is introducing document-level prompting for custom document processors. This feature allows you to provide an overall description of the document to inject deep business knowledge into the model, leading to improved extraction quality.

sources.title: Document AI Models and Tasks - DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This page provides an overview of Document AI models and tasks available in the Transformers-Tutorials repository. Document AI refers to AI systems designed to understand, analyze, and extract information from document images, including text, layout, tables, and other visual elements.
